newsitem.title: UK: UK government will not lose Chancellor - Major.
newsitem.headline: UK government will not lose Chancellor - Major.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major denied on Sunday that he would be prepared to lose Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke in order to increase his chances of winning the general election by appeasing Eurosceptics.

Asked if it was a choice between losing the general election or losing the Chancellor he said the government was not going to lose the election and added, "we will not lose the Chancellor." Major decribed Clarke as "a very fine" finance minister who had delivered the best economic figures for a very long time. "The Chancellor of the Exchequer is going to stay there."
